Package io.telekom.orchest.scheduling.runtime

Class DefaultTaskScheduler

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.scheduling.runtime.DefaultTaskScheduler
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskScheduler
public class DefaultTaskScheduler extends Object implements TaskScheduler
Default TaskScheduler implementation — a thin facade over a ScheduledTaskStore.

Producer-side concerns only: enqueue, cancel, look up. Polling, leasing and dispatching live in TaskDispatcher. The two are deliberately split so producer-only services (e.g. orchest-engine) can depend on the scheduler without paying the cost of running dispatcher threads.
